reason: Named independent lab, batch report behind the QR code, no magnesium oxide and a dose on the box is exactly what I check before buying. $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee is low risk, so I would try one box.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule? I would also want to open the lab report and check the batch number matches before I order.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be missing, generic, or not matching the batch number, I would not buy.
